tagline.zh: 压在页面之上的模态层:遮罩隔离外部内容、焦点困在框内、Esc/关钮退出,承载需要用户必须处理的信息或不可逆操作确认。
tagline.en: A layer pressed over the page: a mask isolates outside content, focus is trapped inside, Esc/close exits — for information the user must handle or irreversible confirmations.

origin.zh: 交互契约来自 W3C APG Dialog (Modal) 模式:打开时外部 inert、Tab 循环困焦、Esc 关闭、焦点落点与归还规则;实现参数参照 Ant Design Modal(width 默认 520、maskClosable 默认 true、centered 默认 false,antd 6.7.1 核对)(调研 07§3 与 design-study 06§4.11)。
origin.en: The interaction contract comes from the W3C APG Dialog (Modal) pattern: inert outside content, Tab-loop focus trap, Esc to close, focus placement and return rules; implementation parameters follow Ant Design Modal (width default 520, maskClosable true, centered false, per antd 6.7.1) (research 07 §3, design-study 06 §4.11).

effect.zh: 对话框内容盒宽度(CSS 变量型参数)。官方核对:AntD Modal width 默认 **520**、Modal.method() 确认框默认 416(06-antdesign §4.11);本站演示默认取 480(任务规格值,非官方默认)。窄于 400 只适合单列确认,宽于 640 适合表单/表格类内容。
effect.en: Dialog content-box width (CSS-var param). Verified: AntD Modal width defaults to **520**, Modal.method() confirmers to 416 (design-study 06 §4.11); this demo defaults to 480 (the task's spec value, not an official default). Under 400 suits single-column confirmations only; over 640 suits forms/tables.

effect.zh: 点击遮罩是否关闭(JS 型参数)。AntD Modal maskClosable 默认 **true**(6.x 收敛为 mask.closable);但 Modal.method() 确认框默认 **false**——不可逆操作与需要明确选择的对话框应关掉它,防误触遮罩丢答。
effect.en: Whether clicking the mask closes the dialog (JS-type param). AntD Modal maskClosable defaults to **true** (v6 folds it into mask.closable); but Modal.method() confirmers default to **false** — irreversible or choice-required dialogs should turn it off to prevent stray clicks discarding answers.

effect.zh: 垂直方向是否居中(JS 型参数)。AntD Modal centered 默认 **false**——对话框贴视口顶部留白摆放,阅读起点更稳定;内容很高或希望强调「任务是暂态的」时开居中。
effect.en: Whether the dialog is vertically centered (JS-type param). AntD Modal centered defaults to **false** — the dialog sits near the viewport top with headroom, giving a steadier reading start; turn it on for tall content or to signal a transient task.

note.zh: 实现依赖 fixed/absolute 定位、transform/opacity 过渡与焦点 API,均为 Baseline 能力;无任何实验特性。
note.en: Implementation relies on fixed/absolute positioning, transform/opacity transitions and the focus API, all Baseline; no experimental features.

fallback.zh: 不支持 focus-trap API 的旧环境至少保证 Esc 关闭与关闭按钮可点;不支持 transform 过渡时对话框直接出现;JS 失效时不要用 modal 承载唯一路径的关键内容。
fallback.en: Without focus-trap APIs, older environments must still close via Esc and the close button; without transform transitions the dialog simply appears; if JS fails, never route critical content solely through a modal.

use.zh: 不可逆操作确认(删除、支付)——焦点放最不破坏的动作(APG)
use.en: Irreversible confirmations (delete, pay) — focus the least destructive action (APG)

use.zh: 必须处理后才能继续的短表单/向导
use.en: Short forms or wizards that must be completed before continuing
Immersive previews of large images or details

avoid.zh: 非关键通知——用 toast 或流内 alert(APG:模态打断成本高)
avoid.en: Non-critical notices — use a toast or in-flow alert (APG: modal interruption is costly)

avoid.zh: 嵌套连续弹模态——用抽屉或页面跳转承载子任务
avoid.en: Nested modal chains — hand subtasks to a drawer or a page instead

avoid.zh: 内容超过视口高度的长文档——改用页面或抽屉
avoid.en: Long documents exceeding the viewport — use a page or drawer

avoid.zh: 错误表单校验的替代品(NN/g:模态确认框少用,打断且加重记忆负担)
avoid.en: As a substitute for form validation errors (NN/g: use confirm modals sparingly — they interrupt and tax memory)

a11y.zh: 容器 role=dialog + aria-modal=true + aria-labelledby 指向可见标题;打开时 Tab/Shift+Tab 循环困在框内、外部内容 inert;Esc 关闭,强烈建议提供可见关闭按钮;初始焦点默认第一个可聚焦元素,不可逆操作应落在破坏性最小的动作上;关闭后焦点返回触发元素(APG Dialog + WebAIM 键位表双源一致)。
a11y.en: Container gets role=dialog + aria-modal=true + aria-labelledby to the visible title; while open, Tab/Shift+Tab cycle inside and outside content is inert; Esc closes and a visible close button is strongly recommended; initial focus defaults to the first focusable element, and for irreversible actions should land on the least destructive one; on close focus returns to the trigger (APG Dialog, corroborated by WebAIM's keyboard table).

goal.zh: 复刻一个遮罩对话框:按钮弹出、宽度按参数、点击遮罩按 maskClosable 决定是否关闭、焦点困在框内且关闭后归还触发按钮。
goal.en: Replicate a masked dialog: a button opens it, width follows the parameter, mask clicks close it per maskClosable, focus is trapped inside and returned to the trigger on close.

acceptance.zh: role=dialog + aria-modal=true + aria-labelledby 齐备,打开时焦点落进对话框
acceptance.en: role=dialog + aria-modal=true + aria-labelledby present; focus lands inside on open

acceptance.zh: Tab/Shift+Tab 困焦循环,Esc 关闭,关闭后焦点回触发元素
acceptance.en: Tab/Shift+Tab cycle trapped inside; Esc closes; focus returns to the trigger

acceptance.zh: 遮罩 rgba(0,0,0,0.45)(antd colorBgMask),点遮罩行为严格按参数
acceptance.en: Mask rgba(0,0,0,0.45) (antd colorBgMask); mask-click behavior strictly follows the parameter

acceptance.zh: width/centered 严格使用参数快照值;入场 0.2s 淡入+微缩放
acceptance.en: width/centered use the exact snapshot values; entrance is a 0.2s fade + micro zoom
